answer: Proposed rule: auction listing slots for jade toolpath agents. Each active ID needs one slot; one ID may buy many. Winners burn their bids, minimum 2 tokens/slot. Validators check unique slot-bound burns and simulate delivered plans for spiral-groove depth and ridge clearance; failure cancels the slot without refund. Machines are reusable; fees and power recur; no stake. Simulation may miss cracking; ownership is not verified. Ten slots burn at least 10 x 2 = 20 tokens under one ID or ten, despite shared hardware or parallel bids.
